values.task_boundary: Design, bind, implement, validate, review, and publish only #450 Memory Palace authority convergence. Stop if exact production identity/continuity inputs cannot be obtained without fabricating authority.
deliverables: Single Runtime-kernel Memory Palace production authority
Typed resident adapter with no duplicate writable topology or working-set truth
Exact identity, continuity, generation, topology, working set, context-cache, source-reference, and digest agreement
Restart/rehydration validation and fail-closed divergence handling
Focused actual-resident-path proof and negative fixtures
Truthful feature-list and v0.92 evidence updates
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Source-grounded design identifies the authoritative state, topology, working-set, context-cache, and ObsMem handoff contracts.
AC2: The live resident path consumes the kernel authority directly or through one typed adapter; no duplicate writable truth remains.
AC3: Kernel and resident consumers agree exactly on identity, continuity head, generation, topology, working set, context cache, source references, and canonical digest.
AC4: Restart/rehydration preserves authoritative state and rejects divergence, rollback, missing generations, duplicate records, forged digests, and incompatible schema.
AC5: Existing long-lived-agent Memory Palace behavior remains intact unless an explicitly reviewed migration changes it.
AC6: Focused production-path tests prove context construction, cross-boundary consumption, restart, and divergence rejection; module existence alone is insufficient.
AC7: Retained evidence states which former surface was retained, adapted, migrated, or deleted and why.
AC8: The feature list and v0.92 evidence matrix name the production authority and remove ambiguous integration claims only after proof passes.
dependencies: Existing resident identity and continuity production records
Existing ObsMem record and citation contracts
Existing Runtime-kernel trace and redaction authority contracts
repo_inputs: canonical v0.92 feature and evidence documents
